title: CalGS: calibrated genomic selection with split-conformal prediction intervals (code and simulated sesame panel)
description: Complete, seeded pipeline for the manuscript 'Calibrated genomic selection: distribution-free prediction intervals turn deep genomic prediction into a decision tool'. Simulates a sesame-like diversity panel (430 inbred accessions, founder-mosaic relatedness, five traits with pleiotropy, epistasis and G×E across six environments), fits GBLUP, MLP, 1D-CNN and a patch-based genomic transformer, evaluates native, Gaussian and split-conformal prediction intervals against known true breeding values, and regenerates every table and figure. All data are simulated.
